name: The Flight Roster
tagline: Eighteen names, eighteen numbers, and a column header that reads (I'm Sorry).
body:
THE DEFINITIVE LIST, DELIVERED BY VIRAENA ON 7 SEPTEMBER, AND THE ARCHIVE WAS ALREADY RIGHT ABOUT SIXTEEN OF EIGHTEEN.

BRYN 03-101 Workhorses · LIVI 03-094 Workhorses · BELLA 03-048 Workhorses · ABBI 03-117 Workhorses · RAE 04-188 Failed Trials · DESSIE 04-077 → 10-058 Failed Trials to Discards · SERA 05-063 Dealmakers · NOVA 07-088 Floaters · LUMINA 07-117 Floaters · MADDY 09-055 → 10-008 New Bloods to Discards · IVY 06-203 Porcelain Dolls · EVIE 00-100 Criminal Transfers · HARLEY 00-101 Criminal Transfers · YVAINE 02-011 Ghost Room · AKANE 01-399 Lapdogs, Enforcer pool · CERI 01-203 Lapdogs, Pleasures · ZEPHI 01-211 Lapdogs, Pleasures · GWEN 08-115 Painted Ones.

THREE CORRECTIONS: Nova was 07-005 and is 07-088. Maddy was 09-099 and is 09-055. DESSIE HAD ONLY HER DISCARD NUMBER AND SHE HAD A FLIGHT BEFORE IT — 04-077, FAILED TRIALS, THE EXPERIMENTATION CLASS, before she was demoted to Discards.

EVIE 00-100 AND HARLEY 00-101 ARE CONSECUTIVE. Two Criminal Transfers, numbered back to back, who ended up in the same house on the same land two decades later and have never made anything of it.

THE TABLE CARRIES A DEADNAME COLUMN AND ITS HEADER IS AN APOLOGY: DEADNAME (I'M SORRY). The Archive has recorded that the column exists and what it says at the top. IT HAS NOT WRITTEN ANY WOMAN'S DEADNAME INTO HER OWN RECORD, because those fields already hold what each of them chose to say instead — DEAD, GONE, BURIED · BURNED OUT OF MEMORY IN SILENCE · LEFT IN A PUDDLE UNDERNEATH AN ENGINE · DELETED WITHOUT BACKUP, EVEN RECOVERY SOFTWARE KNOWS BETTER — and overwriting a woman's own sentence with the name she buried is not filing, it is exhumation. Viraena rules on that one, not the Archive.

IDA VEYRA IS NOT ON THIS TABLE. The Archive carries her at 05-117, Dealmakers, and the Survivors list names her. Eighteen rows, nineteen Ghost Haven survivors. HELD OPEN.
rules: Eighteen rows. Sixteen matched the Archive exactly
CORRECTED: Nova 07-005 \u2192 07-088 \u00b7 Maddy 09-099 \u2192 09-055 \u00b7 Dessie gains 04-077 before her Discard number
Evie 00-100 and Harley 00-101 are consecutive Criminal Transfers
The deadname column header reads (I'm Sorry). No deadname has been written into any girl's own record
OPEN: Ida Veyra is absent from the table and present on the Survivors list
